mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate contracting consumer demand that signals reduced corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), a federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals robust supply chain activity that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% quarter-over-quarter.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,350,000 annual units signal strong consumer confidence and spending that boosts corporate revenue expectations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1,350,000 units annually.

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), strong payroll growth above 200,000 jobs signals labor market tightness that may trigger wage inflation and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 200, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP growth rate above 1.0% year-over-year signals economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 increases by at least 1.0% year-over-year.
